issues.description: Method mismatch for Stock.take(String): The problem statement's UML and the solution implementation declare Stock.take(String) to return an int (used to indicate remaining quantity or -1 on failure). However, the template repository declares Stock.take(String) with return type boolean. This inconsistency will cause compilation errors or incorrect behavior when students implement SealSaloon.checkOrderReady() (which in the spec/solution expects an int return and checks for -1).
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the template implementation to match the specification and solution: change the signature of take to 'public int take(String ingredient)' and adjust its implementation to return -1 when the ingredient is missing or out of stock, and otherwise return the new quantity after decrementing. Update any template callers or comments accordingly so students can implement SealSaloon and checkOrderReady() following the problem statement without compilation errors.
